verdict.rationale: Warp documents a built-in agent that plans and executes multi-step tasks, runs shell commands, reads live output and drives interactive programs (warp-docs-44, warp-docs-80, warp-docs-16). The user stays in the loop by approving actions and reviewing diffs (warp-docs-81, warp-docs-82), with configurable autonomy and command-execution permissions (warp-docs-64, warp-docs-66). Community users report delegating sysadmin and file-cleanup tasks to it (warp-comm-9, warp-comm-10), though one Pro user reports random failures and agents stopping (warp-comm-17). missing for 10: in-depth documentation of per-command approval granularity and the plan-review flow, and consistent independent reports of reliability.
